- Expanded compatibility description to mention Codex and similar harnesses, in addition to Claude Code.
- Added explicit file path pattern under `paths` (now matches all `.go` files).
- Introduced "Orchestration mode" with multi-agent parallelism for large codebase refactoring.
- Removed the deprecated `skill-card.md` file.
- Updated metadata to version 1.3.0.
summary: Comprehensive guide for dependency injection (DI) in Golang. Covers why DI matters (testability, loose coupling, separation of concerns, lifecycle management), manual constructor injection, and DI library comparison (google/wire, uber-go/dig, uber-go/fx, samber/do). Use this skill when designing service architecture, setting up dependency injection, refactoring tightly coupled code, managing singletons or service factories, or when the user asks about inversion of control, service containers, or wiring dependencies in Go. For a specific DI library, → See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-google-wire`, `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-dig`, `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-fx`, or `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-do` skills.
